title: Xdrip+ in Android Wear watch?
symptom: User wants to use a Libre-Blucon-Smartwatch combination as a CGM with alarms, wearing a Sony SmartWatch 3 without a phone. They tried Xdrip but don't get any graphs, and the Xdrip Wear App is only seen as alerts. After restoring firmware, they still don't get any Xdrip app or watch face, only alerts.
fix: Updating to the Oct25th version of Xdrip instantly gave the watch face, enabling a Libre-Blucon CGM on the Sony Smartwatch 3.
evidence_quote: I updated to Oct25th version of Xdrip and instantly got the watch face.
